ABOUT US:Astro Mechanica is a vertically integrated aerospace company building a faster, more connected future. Our mission is to democratize high-speed flight by making supersonic travel flexible, accessible, and sustainable. We believe that rapid, on-demand, point-to-point global mobility will become the new standard for moving people and goods across the planet. To achieve this, we are integrating our advanced airframe and engine technologies—which include Duality™, our proprietary dual-use propulsion system—with a new flight operations model to make supersonic transport as efficient and economical as commercial air travel is today. In the near term, we are developing adaptable, high-speed systems to close aircraft performance gaps for the United States government.

WHO WE ARE:We’re a team of passionate engineers dedicated to advancing aerospace. We’re generalists with specialist depth, united by a flat structure and a shared obsession with building things that work well. We move fast, stay pragmatic, and let engineering excellence speak louder than hierarchy.

WHO YOU ARE:You have done this before. Not necessarily at an aerospace company, but at a fast-scaling, high-stakes, technically complex organization where the People function had to grow in real time. You've owned the full stack of HR, you've built teams and systems from scratch, and you've made decisions under ambiguity without waiting for a playbook to materialize. 

You are a strong operator and credible strategic partner. You understand what it means to recruit in a competitive technical talent market. You've hired engineers and operators who had better-resourced options but chose your company anyway.

You have a high standard for your craft- the work you produce, the processes you build, and the people you hire. You care about getting it right, not just getting it done. That will resonate here. 

 WHAT YOU’LL DO:This is the first dedicated executive People hire at Astro Mechanica. You will own all HR functions: talent acquisition, people operations, total rewards, performance management, employee experience, compliance, and organizational design. You will inherit a foundation built by an internal lead who has done exceptional work getting the company from 0 to 1, and you will take it the rest of the way.

This is not a role for someone who needs to learn the craft of People leadership on the job. Astro Mechanica is moving too fast for that. You need to know what good looks like across all HR functions, make decisions quickly, and build systems that work today and hold up at 5x the current size.

You report to the COO and partner closely with the CEO and technical leadership. This is a seat at the leadership table. You are expected to contribute to company strategy, not just execute on HR programs.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:10+ years of progressive HR/People leadership, with meaningful time as a functional owner, not just a business partner

Experience at a company that scaled rapidly (ideally from under 100 to several hundred people) and kept its culture intact

Demonstrated success building in-house talent acquisition functions (not just managing agencies)

Strong track record recruiting and retaining technical talent in a competitive market

Experience with California employment law and the specific risks it creates for fast-moving companies is helpful but not required

Exposure to manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or other hardware-intensive industries is a meaningful plus. You don't need to have built jet engines, but you need to be able to earn the trust of people who do

Prior experience designing performance management systems that actually work in practice

Comfort operating in companies where not everything is defined yet and preference for building over inheriting

PERKS & BENEFITS:Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, including Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)

401(k) program and transparent stock option plan

Self-managed and flexible time-off policy, including PTO, paid holidays, and sick time

Flexible work environment

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:At Astro Mechanica, we highly value in-office work to foster collaboration and strengthen our company culture. We consider working in the office five days a week an essential part of the employee's role.

Astro Mechanica is an equal opportunity employer. We proudly recruit and hire a diverse workforce and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

About BJAK  We build superior application platforms globally with the mission of creating successful businesses while contributing positively to society by making it more efficient.  

We developed the first and leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia to digitize the insurance industry. The platform currently serves over 8 million users across the region.  

We are continuing our mission by building new, superior applications in emerging use cases as applications become increasingly integrated with AI.  

Our team is densely talented, highly motivated, and focused on engineering and product excellence within a very flat organization. All members are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission.

 About the roleWe are looking for a hands-on Head of People to own and operate the full spectrum of human resources across BJAK’s global organization.

This role covers employees across Malaysia, Thailand, Japan, Indonesia, Hong Kong, China, the UK, and the US, spanning both on-site and remote teams. You will be responsible for building, running, and scaling the HR function in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.

This is not a purely managerial, strategic or policy-driven role. You are expected to build & drive execution, particularly in hiring, performance management, leadership support, and complex people matters, while progressively building systems and a small, high-quality HR team around you. You will work closely with founders and senior leaders, acting as both a trusted leader and a practical problem-solver.

 What you will be doingOwn the end-to-end HR function globally, including Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partnering, Employee Engagement, Learning & Development, Payroll, Compensation & Benefits, and HR Operations.

Personally lead and support critical hiring across technical, commercial, and corporate roles, ensuring hiring quality, speed, and consistency across regions.

Partner closely with founders and senior leaders on organisation design, workforce planning, performance management, succession planning, and leadership development.

Build and operate performance management, feedback, and development frameworks that are simple, practical, and actively used by managers.

Drive employee engagement initiatives that strengthen alignment, retention, and execution, while avoiding unnecessary bureaucracy.

Act as a hands-on HRBP for senior leaders and managers, supporting day-to-day people decisions, performance issues, and organizational changes.

Own global payroll, compensation, benefits, and employment structures, ensuring accuracy, fairness, and compliance across all countries.

Manage HR compliance, employment contracts, policies, and statutory requirements across multiple jurisdictions, working with external advisors or EORs where needed.

Design and continuously improve HR processes and systems that scale with the business without slowing it down.

Build, mentor, and lead the HR team over time, with a strong bias toward high ownership and execution.

 What you will needProven experience leading end-to-end HR in a fast-growing, international organization.

Strong hands-on background with the ability to operate at both strategic and execution levels.

Experience managing HR across multiple countries, including a mix of local entities, remote employees, and third-party employment structures.

Solid expertise across talent acquisition, performance management, employee relations, compensation & benefits, payroll, and HR operations.

Strong judgment and business acumen, with the ability to make pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations.

High ownership mindset - comfortable rolling up sleeves and solving problems directly.

Ability to work closely with founders and senior leaders in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment.

About A1There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.

 RolePeople systems are the foundation of how organisations hire, manage, and develop talent. We are looking for a Head of People Systems who can design and own the technology infrastructure behind recruiting, HR operations, and workforce data.

This role sits at the intersection of People Operations and Engineering. It combines systems architecture thinking with a deep understanding of how modern organisations hire, operate, and scale.

You will design and build the systems infrastructure that supports a growing, world-class team, enabling scalable hiring, efficient operations, and reliable workforce data across the company.

 What You'll DoDefine the People Systems Strategy

Define the long-term systems architecture supporting recruiting, HR operations, and workforce data

Assess current HR and recruiting systems and identify opportunities to improve automation, data quality, and operational efficiency

Design a scalable technology foundation for hiring, employee lifecycle management, and workforce analytics

Ensure people systems support rapid company growth and data-driven decision-making

Build the People Systems Infrastructure

Design and implement systems supporting recruiting workflows, employee lifecycle management, and internal operations

Evaluate, integrate, and manage HR technology platforms and internal tools

Build reliable integrations across recruiting systems, HRIS, payroll, and internal data platforms

Ensure data quality, governance, privacy, and security across all People systems

Drive the Systems Roadmap

Establish and maintain a clear roadmap for People systems and HR technology

Prioritize improvements that increase operational efficiency and data visibility

Partner closely with engineering teams to implement systems and integrations effectively

Partner with Leadership

Work closely with People, Recruiting, Operations, and Engineering leaders

Ensure people systems support workforce planning, hiring velocity, and organisational growth

Improve employee experience through well-designed systems and processes

Help leadership make better decisions through reliable workforce data

 What You'll NeedStrong experience with HR systems, recruiting systems, or internal operational platforms

Technical background: degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on technical experience. You can speak fluently with engineers about APIs, data models, system architecture, and integration patterns

Strong understanding of systems architecture, data pipelines, and integration patterns

Experience building or scaling people systems in a growing organisation is a plus

Ability to translate operational needs into effective systems

 How We WorkThe best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams.  We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning.  Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 Interview processIf there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, the process to offer may be shorter.

About the organizationFAR.AI is a non-profit AI research institute dedicated to ensuring advanced AI is safe and beneficial for everyone. We work at the intersection of machine learning, safety research, and policy, supporting a global community of researchers and practitioners. At FAR.AI, we believe in thoughtful, inclusive, and scalable operations that empower our team and partners to do their best work.

Since our founding in July 2022, we've grown quickly to 40+ staff, producing 30+ influential academic papers, and established the leading AI Safety events for research and international cooperation. Our work is recognized globally, with publications at premier venues and features in the Financial Times, Nature News, Forbes, and MIT Technology Review.

We drive practical change through red-teaming with frontier model developers and government institutions. Most recently, we discovered major issues with Anthropic’s latest model the same day it was released, and worked with OpenAI to safeguard their latest model. Additionally, we help steer and grow the AI safety field through developing research roadmaps with renowned researchers such as Yoshua Bengio. We also operate FAR.Labs, an AI safety-focused co-working space in Berkeley, housing 40 members, as well as support the community through targeted grants to technical researchers.

The RoleWe are hiring a Head of People to build the systems, team, and culture that will carry FAR.AI from 40 people to 75+ over the next 12 months, across multiple geographies and entities. You’ll have the unique opportunity to build our people operations function, crafting and executing the systems, processes, and culture that will support our continued growth. This means taking ownership of the entire employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to employee engagement, retention, and beyond. 

You’ll report to the COO and work closely with our leadership team and other department leads, bringing structure to everything people-related and creating an environment where employees can do their best work. If you’re an impact-driven leader who has built and scaled People functions in fast-moving organizations and are looking for your next organization to make a mark on, this is the role for you.

Why This Role / Why NowFAR.AI is entering a pivotal phase of growth, backed by over $40M in funding and expanding opportunities to shape how advanced AI systems are developed and governed. Our work spans technical research, policy, and operations, including partnerships, such as red-teaming frontier models with leading AI companies and governments. As the scope and impact of our work accelerate, we are leveling up our operational capacity.

 As FAR.AI's Head of People, you will lay the foundation that enables everything we do, from talent acquisition, people operations, culture, and employee engagement. FAR.AI runs the events, programs, HR, communications, and community spaces that connect the global AI safety ecosystem. If you join our operations team, you're not supporting a company; you're building the institutional backbone of a field that didn't exist five years ago. You'll work with policymakers, Turing Award winners, and frontier lab experts, and you'll help define how the organization scales through a critical growth phase.

 For people leaders who enjoy building, proactive problem solving, and rolling up their sleeves to get things done, this is a rare opportunity to drive long-term societal impact.

 If this sounds like you, then we would love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

Own and build the People function across the following areas:

People operations and infrastructure. Own HRIS, payroll coordination, employee lifecycle (onboarding through offboarding), ATS, immigration, and the systems and policies that make day-to-day people operations smooth and consistent across geographies.

Talent acquisition. Own the hiring end-to-end: pipeline strategy, sourcing, employer brand, candidate experience, interview design, and offer process. Partner with hiring managers to scope roles tightly and fill empty seats with top talent. Analyze recruitment data and market trends to inform future hiring strategies.

Performance and management systems. Build and maintain the practices that make managers effective, including quarterly performance reviews, professional development, and a no-surprises approach to underperformance.

Compensation and benefits. Own compensation philosophy, leveling, benchmarking, and benefits administration across the US and other geographies, including EOR.

People compliance. Own employment compliance across jurisdictions, including federal and state requirements in the US and other countries where FAR.AI employs staff.

Culture and employee experience. Steward the practices, rituals, and feedback processes that keep FAR.AI a place where talented people do their best work. Oversee initiatives to foster a positive, inclusive, and high-performance work environment. Help us stay connected by coordinating quarterly team events, including offsites, team-building activities, and social gatherings.

A People partner to the organization. Resolve people ops inquiries and issues with empathy and efficiency. Be a trusted advisor to the CEO, President, and COO on org design, compensation, leveling, succession, and sensitive personnel decisions.

Team leadership. Hire, develop, and manage the People team as it grows. Model the management standard you expect of others.

Must-Have Qualifications

7+ years of progressive experience in HR or People, including at least 3 years leading a People team or a major sub-function.

Proven results filling difficult seats with top talent in full-cycle recruiting, preferably with technical roles. Has employed innovative strategies for sourcing and building an employer brand.

Demonstrated experience scaling a people function through significant headcount growth. The organization is doubling year-on-year.

Hands-on experience owning or substantially building at least three of: HRIS implementation, performance management systems, compensation frameworks, hiring infrastructure, or international employment via EOR.

Operator mindset and comfortable building out systems, processes, and teams. Biased toward simple solutions over heavy process. Comfortable with ambiguity and can independently drive the people function.

Strong judgment on sensitive personnel matters, with a default toward direct, candid, and respectful communication.

Natural relationship builder with strong interpersonal skills. The ability to build trust and collaborate effectively with candidates and internal stakeholders. Crafts thoughtful and effective messages that pitches FAR.AI’s mission and opportunities compellingly.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Experience in fast-paced environments. You've worked in startups, nimble nonprofits, or high-growth teams before and can adapt to change quickly.

Technical acumen or familiarity with AI or related technical fields, allowing you to engage credibly with candidates and work effectively with technical staff and leadership.

Direct experience employing staff internationally, including via EOR.

Experience building or running a global compensation philosophy across countries.

Experience building systems, processes, and culture in a hybrid or remote environment.

Experience contributing to an impact-driven organization or passionate about AI safety.

Logistics

You will be a full-time employee of FAR.AI, a 501(c)(3) research non-profit.

Location: Berkeley, CA (onsite/hybrid) or Remote, based in the US.

Hours: Full-time (40 hours/week).

Compensation: $150,000-$200,000/year depending on experience. We will also pay for work-related travel and equipment expenses, and offer catered lunch and dinner at our office in Berkeley.

Hiring process: A phone screen, a hiring manager interview, a task test, in-depth interviews with the team, followed by reference checks.

lumos:29f0a069-345f-495f-9e9e-81bebaefdc.description:
Every breach, every failed audit, every new hire stuck in onboarding purgatory traces back to the same question: who has access to what — and should they?

Identity is where modern companies break. Too much access leaks data. Too little grinds the business to a halt. Lumos is the industry's first Autonomous Identity Platform — software that doesn't just surface access risk, but acts on it. We started with a self-service AppStore and grew into the critical infrastructure connecting apps, identities, and data for GitHub, MongoDB, Mars, Pinterest, Anduril, Intercom, Roku, and Netskope. At the center is Albus, our AI agent for identity — mining roles, approving access, and catching the drift humans miss.

You'll ship work that thousands of IT and security teams touch every day. You'll own problems without playbooks, because the category is being redefined in real time — by us.

Why Lumos?

🚀 Jump on a rocketship. Since launching out of stealth in April 2022, we've grown from 20 to ~130 Alchemists and raised over $65M from a16z, Scale, Neo, Greg Brockman (President at OpenAI), and Phil Venables (CISO at Google). 

⭐ Customers love us — and so does the industry. Named a Strong Performer in the 2026 Gartner Voice of the Customer for IGA — 4.7/5, with 96% of reviewers saying they'd recommend us. Our customers cut time-to-access by 98%, slash IT tickets by 72%, and eliminate excess privilege at scale.

🏆 A culture worth joining. Three years running on Forbes' Top 100 Best Startup Employers in America (2024, 2025, 2026) — measured on culture, retention, growth, and job creation. That's our Alchemists, not our marketing. See what we live by here.

As the Head of People at Lumos, you have a massive opportunity to design and build the People function that scales Lumos from ~130 to 300+ Alchemists — and to be the trusted partner every Lumos leader turns to for advice on talent, performance, and team-building. You will be the architect of how Lumos develops its managers, how Lumos's people programs run at scale, and how Lumos shows up as a place world-class operators want to do the best work of their careers.

✨ Your ResponsibilitiesBe the strategic HR partner to the executive team — org design, leadership development, succession planning, and the highest-stakes people decisions across the org

Design and deploy scalable people programs — career frameworks, performance, compensation, onboarding — that run on documented cadence, not heroics

Build and lead the People team — own hiring, structure, and team development as we scale through Series C

Own and elevate the Lumos manager experience — build and run repeatable training programs that turn every Lumos manager into a developer of people, starting the day they post their first req

Steward Lumos culture as we grow — protect what makes Lumos distinctive while building the infrastructure for what comes next

🙌 What We're Looking For8+ years in People/HR, with at least 3 in a leadership role owning a function or a major program

Scaled a People function through the 100 → 250+ inflection at a high-growth SaaS/tech company — you've personally lived what breaks at 150 and how to fix it

Builder, not inheritor: shipped new manager development, performance, comp, and onboarding programs from scratch — you can point to the artifacts

Manager-centric philosophy: you deeply believe great people functions are built through great managers, and you have the receipts to prove it

Trusted strategic partner to senior leaders — comfortable in high-stakes conversations with CEOs and founders; discreet, decisive, and able to bring outside-in perspective

Operational rigor: you run the function on documented, repeatable rhythms — not one-off heroics

Nice to have: HiBob (or similar modern HRIS) experience, coaching credential or background, international / EOR experience (Deel, Remote, etc.)

⭐️ What We ValueWe also care about whether you would be a good fit for Lumos based on the values and characteristics that define how we achieve outcomes, not just your resume.

Thank you for considering Lumos, we hope to hear from you! 🎉

💰 Pay Range$215,000-$280,000 Note that this range is a good faith estimate of likely pay for this role; upon hire, the pay may differ due to skill and/or level of experience.

💸 Benefits and Perks:

💻 Remote-first culture – Work from anywhere within ±4 hours of Pacific Time.

🏥 Medical, dental & vision insurance – 100% of premiums covered for employees, 60% for dependents. HSA and FSA available with employer contribution. International benefits align with local standards.

🧠 Mental health support – Access to mental health resources and support.

💪 Monthly wellness stipend – A monthly stipend for gym memberships, fitness apps, and whatever helps you recharge.

🛡️ Life & disability insurance – Life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage available.

🌴 Flexible PTO – Flexible time off with a minimum annual requirement, because rest is part of doing your best work.

👶 Parental leave – Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for expecting parents.

📚 $1,000 annual learning stipend – An annual budget for courses, books, conferences, and certifications.

✈️ Company & team offsites – Company and team bonding trips throughout the year, fully covered by Lumos.

💰 401(k) with matching – Employer 401(k) matching to help you save for the future.

Picogrid is a leading venture-backed defense technology company founded to bridge the decades-long gap between modern technology and the critical demands of national security. Today, we're building the essential infrastructure to unify sensors, autonomy, and operators with our technology deployed in active operations around the world. Our mission is to deliver an operational advantage to secure the United States and its allies.

About the rolePicogrid is seeking a Head of People to build and own our people function as we scale. As our first dedicated People hire, you'll establish the systems, processes, and operating cadence that support the entire employee lifecycle while partnering closely with leadership on performance management, organizational design, and workforce planning.

We're looking for a self-driven builder who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, and taking ownership. You'll lead everything from onboarding and employee relations to HR operations, compliance, and employee experience, creating the foundation that allows the company to scale without adding unnecessary complexity.

Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws while maintaining HR best practices.

Own the company's HRIS, employee records, people reporting, and HR operations, ensuring accuracy and operational excellence.

Own performance management, employee development, and manager coaching across the organization.

Own employee experience initiatives that reinforce a high-performance culture while preserving what makes Picogrid unique.

Demonstrated success building and scaling highly effective people programs with strong retention across compensation, performance management, onboarding, employee relations, and benefits.

Strong working knowledge of federal, state, and local employment laws with the judgment to navigate complex employee situations while balancing business and employee needs.

Experience building scalable people processes, maintaining HR systems, and using data to improve decision-making and operational efficiency.

Exceptional organizational and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and execute in a fast-paced environment.

Comfortable operating with ambiguity, taking ownership of new initiatives, and building processes where none previously existed.

Track record of improving operational efficiency through thoughtful systems, automation, and process design rather than adding unnecessary complexity.

revenuecat:b111bebc-7134-48f7-af79-6adbf.description:
RevenueCat removes the headaches of building and scaling in‑app subscriptions. Since graduating from YC’s S18 batch we’ve grown into the default monetization platform for mobile: we’re in >40% of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $12B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo dev in Brazil to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We’re a remote‑first crew of 150+, spread across 25+ countries, and guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. If you want your work to touch hundreds of millions of end‑users (and help the developers behind them get paid), you’ll fit right in.

We have built a culture centered around ownership, high standards, and customer focus. We’re obsessed with exceptional talent density, and know that it’s critical to our mission.

As RevenueCat continues to grow, the company is investing heavily in the people, systems, and infrastructure to scale.

The role:

RevenueCat is looking for a Head of People to lead talent and people strategy during a pivotal stage of growth. Reporting to the VP of Strategy & Operations, this leader will oversee both Recruiting and People Operations across the organization.

Recruiting is the most immediate area of focus. As RevenueCat scales, the company is looking for someone who can build a world-class recruiting function while also helping evolve broader people programs, organizational design, performance management, and leadership development efforts.

This is a hands-on leadership role. RevenueCat is looking for someone who enjoys operating at both the strategic and tactical levels and who wants to help shape how a rapidly growing company attracts, develops, and retains exceptional talent.

The Head of People will lead:

A growing People team spanning Recruiting and People Operations

Two recruiters today and a recruiting coordinator, with additional hiring planned in the near term

Two dedicated People Operations team members

Talent and people strategy for a globally distributed organization of 150+ employees

Other responsibilities will be:

Build and execute a recruiting strategy that supports significant organizational growth while maintaining talent density.

Improve hiring manager effectiveness, candidate experience, and recruiting operations.

Partner with executives on workforce planning, organizational design, and leadership development.

Continue evolving RevenueCat's performance management and talent development programs.

Build scalable systems and processes that support a globally distributed workforce.

Partner closely with Finance on compensation, headcount planning, and organizational investments.

Leverage automation and AI-enabled workflows to improve recruiting and people operations.

Develop metrics and reporting that improve visibility into hiring performance and organizational health.

Help maintain and strengthen RevenueCat's culture as the company scales.

About you:

You are a builder.

You enjoy creating systems, processes, and teams from the ground up. You know when structure is needed, when simplicity is better, and how to scale organizations without creating unnecessary complexity.

You are talent-obsessed.

You believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional people. You have strong judgment around talent and know how to build recruiting systems that consistently attract and close high-performing candidates.

You are hands-on.

You don't view leadership as delegation. You're comfortable rolling up your sleeves, solving problems directly, and operating wherever the business needs you most.

You are operationally minded.

You use data to inform decisions, build scalable systems, and identify opportunities for improvement. You enjoy turning ambiguity into clarity.

You are AI-curious.

You understand that recruiting, people operations, and organizational design are being transformed by AI. You're excited about leveraging new tools and workflows to help teams operate more effectively.

You are adaptable.

You thrive in fast-moving environments, prioritize effectively, and adjust quickly as business needs evolve.

Experience:

8+ years of experience across recruiting, talent acquisition, people operations, or broader people leadership roles.

Experience building and scaling teams within high-growth technology companies.

Strong recruiting experience, particularly within technical organizations.

Experience partnering directly with executives on talent and organizational decisions.

Experience managing and developing teams.

Strong communication, influence, and stakeholder management skills.

Highly valued:

Experience in talent-dense organizations known for exceptional hiring standards.

Experience within developer tools, infrastructure software, SaaS, fintech, or adjacent technology sectors.

Experience in operations, business operations, or other highly cross-functional leadership environments.

Experience supporting distributed or global organizations.

Experience building AI-enabled recruiting or people workflows.

Experience across both recruiting and people operations functions.

In your first month, you'll:

Meet the People team, leadership team, and key hiring managers.

Go deep on RevenueCat's culture, operating principles, and organizational structure.

Assess the current recruiting function, hiring processes, and talent priorities.

Understand existing people programs, performance management processes, and compensation philosophy.

Identify immediate opportunities for impact.

Develop a roadmap for improving recruiting effectiveness and operational efficiency.

Within your first 3 months, you'll:

Take ownership of recruiting and people operations goals. Show tangible results on recruiting efficiency and execution

Partner with leaders on workforce planning and organizational design initiatives.

Implement improvements to hiring processes, candidate experience, and recruiting operations.

Establish clear metrics and reporting around recruiting and people outcomes.

Within your first 6 months, you'll:

Continue to deliver measurable improvements in hiring quality, speed, and efficiency.

Strengthen collaboration between Recruiting, People Operations, and business leaders.

Improve systems and processes that support organizational growth.

Become a trusted advisor to leaders across the company on talent and people matters.

Help create a more scalable foundation for RevenueCat's next phase of growth.

Within your first 12 months, you'll:

Help scale the company while maintaining a high bar for talent density and performance.

Build a recruiting function that serves as a competitive advantage for RevenueCat.

Establish yourself as a strategic leader across the organization.

Strengthen the people infrastructure needed to support continued growth.

Help shape the long-term vision for the People function as RevenueCat continues to scale.

What we offer:Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

10-year window to exercise vested equity options

Fully remote and flexible work environment

4-5 weeks of suggested time off annually for mental, physical, and emotional recharge

$2,000 USD for workspace setup and $1,000 USD annual stipend for continuous learning

Curious about the interview process? Discover more in our blog post about how we hire and learn tips to help you succeed.
